## Owns
- `services/provisioning/src/steps/render-agent.ts`
- `services/provisioning/src/templates/**`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- Template v0.1.0 renders business name, services, hours in spoken form, policies from verified facts only.
- Disclosure line is short and natural and passes conversation-style (voice, first turn).
- Template versions: canary percentage; tenants pin a version.
